ads.title: The Power of Saying Yes
ads.primary_text:
What would you say yes to if it did not scare you?

Betsy Wentz said yes to all of it.

The advice she gives her own children: take the meeting, take the opportunity. Otherwise you never find out what you could have been.

Founder, Betsy Wentz Interior Design.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.

ads.title: Finding Joy In the Journey
ads.primary_text:
What does it take to call a last-place season the time of your life?

Ryan Malone's first year, the team missed the playoffs and finished at the bottom.

He loved every minute of it. He was playing in the National Hockey League, and he never once treated that as owed to him.

Retired NHL player, Malone Family Foundation.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.

ads.guest_title: Retired NHL player, Malone Family Foundation

ads.title: Sarris Candies Story
ads.primary_text:
How does a Pittsburgh institution start?

With a box of candy that was not very good.

Bill Sarris's father bought it for his mother, felt embarrassed, decided he could do better, and went down to the basement to make his own.

Owner, Sarris Candies.

Living Your Legacy with Greg Weimer. New episodes on YouTube.

ads.title: Lessons Learned from Jerome Bettis
ads.primary_text:
What does character look like when nobody is keeping score?

Beth Vietmeier has traveled the world with Jerome Bettis and has never once seen him turn down a stranger asking for a photo.

She asked him why. He said that if he can make a difference in someone's day, that is what he is here to do.

Founder, Valiant 3 Communications.

ads.title: Start with Your Why
ads.primary_text:
Why do so many good intentions go nowhere?

Andrew DiDonato tells his players that if you are not intentional about something, you will unintentionally do nothing.

He took over a Grove City College team that had not won a game in three years.

Head Football Coach, Grove City College.

ads.title: The Joy of Missing Out
ads.primary_text:
What does it cost to look like you have it all?

Sabrina Saunders Mosby was building a business with an infant at home, telling everyone it was possible.

She was breaking down behind it. So she gave a TED Talk and called it The Joy of Missing Out.

President and Chief Executive Officer, Vibrant Pittsburgh.
